subject.title: [Feature]: Track data provenance across session boundaries for persistent state

question: Should OpenClaw add a core/plugin-API provenance chain for durable state writes and future reads, and what metadata may be persisted or exposed to plugins?
rationale: This chooses a security boundary, public plugin contract, persisted metadata shape, migration behavior, and trust policy that automation cannot safely define.

options.title: Design Minimal Provenance API First
options.body: Keep this open for a focused maintainer/security design that specifies metadata, plugin visibility, migration, and read-time policy before code changes.

options.title: Resolve Hook Prerequisites First
options.body: Settle the before_tool_call provenance and durable persistence-write hook proposals before revisiting cross-session durable provenance.

options.title: Defer To Memory Plugins
options.body: Ask for a concrete plugin implementation to prove the missing core API before adding durable provenance to core.

recommendation.title: Design Minimal Provenance API First
recommendation.body: Keep this open for a focused maintainer/security design that specifies metadata, plugin visibility, migration, and read-time policy before code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal across inter-session provenance and external-content security boundaries.
